newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt to defend salmon ban decision.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt to defend salmon ban decision.

text.p: Australian Primary Industries Minister John Anderson said on Thursday Australia would vigorously defend its ban on uncooked salmon imports.
Canada announced on Wednesday it would take Australia to the World Trade Organisation to settle a dispute over the ban.
"We've acted entirely properly in formulating this decision," Anderson told parliament.
"I want to make it quite plain that this government does not and will not apologise for such a stance."
Anderson said scientific analysis on the issue had shown uncooked salmon contained at least 20 diseases of concern and it was on that basis that the decision was made.

"We will not place our own industries or environment at risk where scientific analysis warrants quarantine restrictions," he said. "We have no intention of placing our clean, safe reputation at risk."
Australia banned fresh salmon imports in 1975, requiring all imported salmon to be either heat-treated or canned.
